acceptanceProtocol.preRegistered: sealed acceptance batch (100 hand-written sentences, fresh slots): strict span match >= 90% per field
acceptanceProtocol.component: both fields pass AND end-to-end <= 4s per call
acceptanceProtocol.protocol: dev batches (classic 10 + grouped) are diagnostics only; the sealed batch is evaluated exactly once via run-labeler-trial.mjs --with-acceptance after dev results justify it; v1 (ec4aa02) and v2 (b5067d7) were each evaluated once and retired

batchSemantics.devGroups: whole GROUPS held out of training; entities/scenarios are disjoint, but sentence patterns recur across splits by design (e.g. 擦亮了灶王爷的牌位 train vs 擦亮了掌柜的烟杆 dev) — evidence supports new-entity/new-scenario evaluation only, NOT unseen-pattern claims
batchSemantics.acceptance: sealed; evaluated exactly once via run-labeler-trial.mjs --with-acceptance

data.attributionNote: 铁门钥匙 case: the pre-coverage model output 生锈, the post-coverage model outputs 铁门钥匙 — model and scoring rule (rule 6 v2) changed together in ec4aa02/b5067d7, so the flip is joint attribution, not 'the rule fixed it'. Historical reports keep their original scores.

runtime.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/153.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/153.0.0.0
runtime.timingScope: end-to-end per call (greedy): text -> tokenize -> feed -> run -> argmax -> span decode; constrained decoding is post-processing on the same logits
runtime.threadNote: single-thread only; >1-thread wasm session create hangs in this environment

errorTaxonomy.note: diagnosis per field is a LIST of defect classes in the order below; a gold span can carry several at once (e.g. truncated-o AND truncated-b in 地下藏书室) — single-primary-class reporting mispointed the cut location. Positions live in the per-token records. No defects -> ["ok"].
errorTaxonomy.ok: no defects (both empty, or exact span match)
errorTaxonomy.span-false: gold empty, model emitted a span
errorTaxonomy.span-missing: gold present, no span decoded for this field
errorTaxonomy.all-o: every gold character predicted O (cause of span-missing)
errorTaxonomy.truncated-o: O predicted inside the entity; the decoded span was cut there
errorTaxonomy.truncated-b: another B- fires inside the entity (first group wins, also cuts)
errorTaxonomy.wrong-field: gold characters or the predicted span land on the OTHER field
errorTaxonomy.over-extended: prediction covers gold entirely but over-extends
errorTaxonomy.boundary-mismatch: prediction overlaps gold but neither contains the other
errorTaxonomy.modifier-as-head: prediction sits entirely in the pre-head modifier/possessor zone (的-separated)
errorTaxonomy.displaced: prediction disjoint from gold, not in the modifier zone, not on the other field's gold

gate.note: sealed acceptance batch was NOT loaded or evaluated (protocol: single-shot via --with-acceptance after dev justifies it); gates: per-field strict >= 90% AND e2e <= 4s on that batch

我和图书馆管理员打听暗门。
我向夏弥打听暗门的来历。
我用朝奉的戥子称了称香料。
我把当票折好收进了钱匣。
我把斗笠扣在了米瓮上。
我把麻缆盘在了缆桩上。
我把水瓢递给了守滩人。
我用那把磨得发亮的剪子铰开了线头。
我把缺了口的粗碗扣在了案板上。
我检查了那盏积灰的油盏。
我用浸过油的火绒引燃了柴堆。
我把卷了角的图纸铺平了。
我用那半截蜡笔涂黑了封皮。
我掀开了蒙着白布的笼屉。
我用斑驳的铜章在封泥上按了个印。
我和诺诺打听图书馆的传闻。
我去二楼档案室查资料。
我使用生锈的铁门钥匙打开大门。
我检查那扇书架后的暗门。
